title: Use of stem cells for the treatment of traumatic brain injury. Multicenter, doubleblind, randomized with placebo phase II clinical trial.
official: Mesenchymal stromal cells for traumatic brain injury. A multicenter, double blind, randomized, placebo-controlled phase II trial
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age: 18-70 years (inclusive)
2. Clinical frailty index (CFI) < 5
3. Evidence of TBI confirmed by abnormalities consistent with trauma on CT scan upon admission (Marshall’s CT Classification >1)
4. Study drug (MSC/placebo) administration within 48 hours from TBI
5. Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) ≤ 8 at recruitment (last valid neurological  assessment before randomization) and at least one pupil reactive to light
6. ICP monitoring, already inserted or planned for clinical indications
7. Weight < 100 Kg and > 40 kg
Exclusion criteria:
1. Motor GCS > 5 at recruitment (last valid neurological assessment before  randomization)
2. Recent serious infectious process requiring ICU admission
3. Cancer (ongoing)
4. Immunosuppression
5. Previous known history of immunodeficiency syndromes, or current  signs/symptoms suggesting immunodeficiency
6. Positive urine pregnancy test
7. Known risk/history of coagulopathy and thromboembolism
8. Pre-existing and severe ongoing: • lung disease (such as asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) • heart dysfunction (as heart failure and reduced cardiac output) • liver insufficiency (as cirrhosis) • kidney insufficiency • and other organ severe abnormalities
9. Known hypersensitivity to excipients used in the formulation (Dimethyl sulfoxide, DMSO; Citratedextrose solution, ACD)
10. Participation in a concurrent interventional study
11. High likelihood (>85%) of death in the first 48 h calculated by IMPACT (International Mission for Prognosis and Analysis of Clinical Trials in TBI) calculator128 on early admission data
12. Bilateral unreactive mydriasis
13. Opening ICP > 40 mmHg
14. Known history of prior brain injury, psychiatric disorder, neurological impairment and/or deficit
15. Brain penetrating injury
16. Spinal cord injury
17. Epilepsy requiring ongoing anti-convulsant therapy
18. Severe organ failure (including PaO2/FiO2<200 and shock)
